bio.body:
Hello, and welcome! 👋

My name is **Mrs Abhinanda Pandit**, and I currently work in a secondary school in Leeds as a **Maths Mentor**. Before that I was an **Assistant SENDCo**, supporting students with additional learning needs and helping them overcome barriers to success.

Teaching has always been more than a profession for me — it is my passion. ❤️ My love of working with young people and helping them reach their full potential inspired me to offer private tutoring, both online and in person from my home in the Middleton area of Leeds.

My journey as a tutor began in my own student years, helping fellow students and junior batches with Physics honours and much else besides. That early experience lit a lifelong passion for teaching and mentoring. ✨

sections.heading: My teaching philosophy
sections.markdown:
✨ ***Every student has the potential to succeed with the right guidance, encouragement and support.***

- 🎯 Every lesson is tailored to individual needs, learning styles and goals.
- 🤗 A safe, supportive space where it is always okay to ask questions and make mistakes.
- 🌱 Confidence, resilience and a positive attitude to learning — not just marks.

sections.heading: My promise
sections.markdown:
- 🌱 Learning is not about being the best — it is about becoming better than you were yesterday.
- 💪 Confidence is the foundation of success, and every lesson is designed to build it.
- 🤝 Together, we can turn challenges into achievements and goals into results.
- ⭐ More than improving grades, my goal is to help students believe in themselves.

I look forward to supporting your child on their educational journey. 😊
